what: a prism over a circular segment whose curved side lies on a SURFACE_OF_LINEAR_EXTRUSION of an ELLIPSE (a = b = 10) and spans the ellipse's parameter origin (-60 to +60 degrees): the face must cover only the narrow segment side, not wrap the ellipse
method: segment of a circle r=10 over theta=2pi/3: A_seg = r^2/2 (theta - sin theta) = 61.418485; height 5; V = A_seg*h = 307.0924; A = 2*A_seg + chord 2 r sin(theta/2)*h + arc r*theta*h = 314.1593; 4 faces, 6 edges, 4 vertices
